newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine's Reynolds sign jv with Hanamura.
newsitem.headline: Philippine's Reynolds sign jv with Hanamura.

text.p: Aluminum sheets and foil maker Reynolds Phils Corp said on Monday it forged a joint venture with Japan's Hanamura Industries Co.

Reynolds Hanamura Aluminum Corp, the joint venture firm, will operate an aluminum remelting plant with an annual output of between 8,000 and 10,000 tonnes annually, Reynolds president Jaime Gonzales said in a statement.
The plant will be built on a 1.2-hectare land acquired by the joint venture from the real estate unit of Reynolds for 28.3 million pesos, he said.
"Our partnership with Hanamura Industries will ensure a state-of-the-art technology in the production of aluminum products," Gonzales added.

Reynold's major shareholders include the Philippines' All Asia Capital and Trust Corp, Marubeni Corp, Nippon Investment Fund's Asia Pacific Ventures Ltd, Fuji Bank subsidiary Fujigin Capital and Yamaichi Securities' Asian Venture Fund.
Reynolds plans to offer 238 million shares in an initial public offering next month. It said the IPO represents 34 percent of its authorised capital.
